newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah stable, swaps ease off slightly.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah stable, swaps ease off slightly.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah opened stable against the dollar after a one-day break in dull trading on Thursday, with swap rates seen easing off slightly.
They said trading in the spot market was thin on lack of fresh factors. "It's mainly a range-trading. We have virtually no idea about the rupiah's trend in the short-term," one said.
Spot rupiah was at 2,406.00/06.75 at 0315 GMT against an opening of 2,405.50/06.25. Tomorrow and today rupiah were at 2,405.5/05.9 and 2,405.2/05.6, respectively.
"I have no view for the rupiah at present. People seem to keep a wait-and-see attitude," one dealer in Singapore said.
